claim: Twenty-one waste containers illegally exported from England to Sri Lanka in 2017 were repatriated to England in October 2020.

metric.denominator: containers in the specific Environment Agency repatriation case
metric.source_definition: illegal waste shipment containers in this case only

bounded_by: One enforcement case does not establish the national scale or dominant source of Sri Lanka's plastic burden.
notes: Provides a distinct transboundary-waste mechanism without inflating its prevalence.
